cases.scenario: Client's age is less than 12 months: Client is not due for rubella vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should not vaccinate client with rubella dose. 
Check for any vaccines due and inform the caregiver of when to come back for the first dose.

cases.scenario: No rubella primary series dose was administered, Client's age is more than or equal to 12 months, and No live vaccine was administered in the last 4 weeks: Client is due for rubella vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should vaccinate client with rubella dose as no rubella doses were administered, client is within appropriate age range and no live vaccine was administered in the last 4 weeks. 
Check for contraindications.

cases.scenario: No rubella primary series dose was administered, Client's age is more than or equal to 12 months, and Live vaccine was administered in the last the 4 weeks: Client is not due for rubella vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should not vaccinate client with rubella dose as live vaccine was administered in the last 4 weeks. 
Check for any other vaccines due.

cases.scenario: One rubella primary series dose was administered: Rubella immunization schedule is complete
cases.guidance:
Rubella immunization schedule is complete. One rubella primary series dose was administered. 
Check for any other vaccines due.
